scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.check: npm run assets:sync && node scripts/check-js.mjs && node scripts/check-game-core.mjs && node scripts/check-session-timing.mjs && node scripts/check-persistence.mjs && node scripts/check-pwa.mjs && node scripts/check-memory-special.mjs && node scripts/check-link-connect-core.mjs && node scripts/check-link-connect-board.mjs && node scripts/check-appearance-themes.mjs && node scripts/check-game-shell-config.mjs && node scripts/check-game-shell-layout.mjs && node scripts/check-game-shell-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/generate-game-shell-tokens.mjs --check
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
